_about: Public-domain John Wilbur Chapman (1859-1918), Presbyterian evangelist, for the Word Hoard: The Ivory Palaces of the King (1893), Received Ye the Holy Ghost? (1894), And Peter (1896), The Lost Crown (1898), The Life of Blessing (1899), The Surrendered Life (1899), The Secret of a Happy Day (1899), Revivals and Missions (1900), The Personal Touch (1900), From Life to Life (1900), The Life and Work of Dwight L. Moody (1900), Day by Day (1901), The Man Who Said He Would (1902), Present-Day Evangelism (1903), Fishing for Men (1904), And Judas Iscariot (1906) and S. H. Hadley of Water Street (1906), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
